item.title: Glide Sinking 14cm - 80g
item.excerpt:
Stick of 14 cm and 80g of weight.

Is perfect for a frenzy fishing of false albacore or bluefin tuna. Well used for reef fishing or in a light tropical fishing from the shore, very good for long cast.

With inline hooks bkk diablo 5/0 or even some trebles, it swims well.
